title: A flow approach to the Toda system
summary: In this paper we introduce a flow to study the Toda system, which we call {\it Toda flow.} More generally, we introduce a flow of the Liouville systems, formulated as a coupled parabolic system with nonlocal interactions. Finite-time singularities are characterized and both necessary and sufficient conditions for convergence are provided in this general setting, even when the prescribed functions are allowed to change sign.
